title: post-merge-verification contract data
description: Reference schema (FAFF-385). The SHAPE of the post-merge verification verdict faff-graft Step 10's shipped arm branches on, after `faff post-merge-check` re-runs the project's own declared UNIT rung (`faff gates`' discoverRungs/runRung, reused verbatim) against an ephemeral detached worktree at the merge-record.json sha. Shape is normative here; the gate SEMANTICS (tracker comment + discovered-scope entry on failure, never auto-revert, never a status flip, never a PR) live in the gateway / faff-graft prose. Coercion target for a malformed verdict is `unverified` (never `verified-ok`), mirroring quality-gates's `needs-human`-never-`pass` rule — the check must never guess green.

command.description: The resolved UNIT-rung command actually run, or null on unverified-by-no-rung.
